title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
summary_en: D²-VLA combines incremental causal key-value caching with separate historical views for the vision-language backbone and action expert. summary_en: This audit executes stored experiences across query scenes to disentangle retrieval-rule quality from experience-library quality. title: SmoLSTM: A Compact Vision-Language-Action Model with Recurrent Memory that Persists
summary_en: SmoLSTM couples a frozen compact vision-language backbone with a matrix-memory LSTM control layer. Observation tokens and action queries share a causal stream whose recurrent state persists throughout an episode, and a flow-matching head reads that state to generate manipulation action chunks.
summary_zh: 冻结紧凑视觉语言骨干，以矩阵记忆 LSTM 在同一因果流中处理观察与动作查询，回合内持续状态供流匹配动作头读取。
analysis_en: Episode-persistent recurrent state needs explicit reset discipline. Storage independent of duration does not imply unlimited information capacity, especially when events interfere or repeat many times.
analysis_zh: 回合持久递归状态需要明确重置；存储不随时长增长不代表无限容量，尤其面对干扰和多次重复。

title: Present but Not Remembered: Auditing How Frozen VLAs Encode, Deploy, and Steer Visual History
summary_en: This audit probes and intervenes on historical representations inside frozen VLAs. It separates whether past-frame content is decodable, whether it adds information beyond the present, and whether actions causally use it, then studies history reinjection under degraded current observations.
summary_zh: 通过探针和因果干预区分历史是否可解码、是否超出当前信息、是否实际影响动作，并研究当前观察退化时的历史重新注入。
analysis_en: Decodability, incremental historical information, and causal action influence are different measurements. This distinction prevents representation probes alone from being treated as proof of functional memory.
analysis_zh: 可解码性、历史增量信息和动作因果影响是不同测量，不能仅凭表示探针证明功能记忆。

title: Training and Evaluating Diffusion Policies with Long Context Lengths

summary_en: DARP predicts actions using neighboring expert states, their demonstrated actions, and differences between each neighbor and the current query. summary_en: HAND extracts a human hand trajectory from a short demonstration and searches task-agnostic robot play data for matching behavior. summary_en: MTIL uses Mamba state-space dynamics to encode an entire observation-action trajectory into an evolving compressed state. title: The Temporal Trap: Entanglement in Pre-Trained Visual Representations for Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary_en: The Temporal Trap examines how static pretrained visual representations entangle states from different phases of a manipulation task. It links representation quality to task-progression cues and proposes a disentanglement baseline, arguing that adding temporal features alone may not resolve ambiguous sequential control.
summary_zh: 研究静态预训练视觉表示对不同任务阶段的混淆，关联潜空间与进度线索并提出消歧基线，检验仅加时序特征的局限。
analysis_en: Progress information in a representation may reflect correlation rather than necessary historical evidence. Counterfactual phase changes help distinguish temporal disentanglement from a learned visual shortcut.
analysis_zh: 表示中的进度可能只是相关性而非必要历史证据，反事实阶段变化可区分时序消歧和视觉捷径。

title: Optimizing Robotic Manipulation with Decision-RWKV: A Recurrent Sequence Modeling Approach for Lifelong Learning
summary_en: Decision-RWKV integrates recurrent sequence modeling with a decision-transformer-style policy and experience replay. The study evaluates this combination in continuous control and dexterous manipulation, examining both single-task decision sequences and retention of skills as the robot learns across tasks.

title: Fly-by-Code: Embodied Coding Agents for Aerial Manipulation with Active Visual and Physical Feedback

summary_en: Fly-by-Code addresses ambiguous execution feedback in aerial manipulation through Active Feedback. title: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: InstAgent organizes heterogeneous robot collaboration as agentic behavior trees that encode capability assignment, dependencies, and handoff checks. title: Functional Cache Grafting: Robust and Rapid Code-Policy Synthesis for Embodied Agents
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: FCGraft stores validated function-level code skeletons alongside their prompt-level Transformer key-value caches. For a new embodied task, it retrieves relevant functions and combines cached segments through stitching and local patching, coupling procedural reuse with reuse of computation during code-policy synthesis.

title: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: Reflective Test-Time Planning combines internal reflection for selecting candidate actions with post-execution reflection that updates the reflection model and action policy. analysis_zh: 经验既用于即时推理，也通过测试时模型更新巩固。比较须区分保留学习与额外推理，并检查回顾纠正是否破坏既有行为。

title: Planning from Imagination: Episodic Simulation and Episodic Memory for Vision-and-Language Navigation
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: Planning from Imagination equips a vision-language navigation agent with hybrid memory that combines observed experience and imagined future scenes. title: Bayesian Relational Memory for Semantic Visual Navigation
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: Bayesian Relational Memory represents semantic entities and their relationships as a probabilistic graph. title: Lifelong Robot Library Learning: Bootstrapping Composable and Generalizable Skills for Embodied Control with Language Models
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: Lifelong Robot Library Learning stores and retrieves experiences through a soft memory module, proposes new simulation tasks, and abstracts recent experience into reusable robot skills. summary_zh: Lifelong Robot Library Learning通过软记忆模块存取经历，自主提出仿真任务，并把近期经验抽象成可复用机器人技能，使知识从上下文记忆逐步进入可组合代码库，在不依赖策略梯度更新时持续学习操作。
analysis_en: The experience-to-library transition is a concrete consolidation mechanism. Avoiding weight updates does not alone prevent forgetting: retrieval interference, incorrect abstraction, and incompatible library extensions still require longitudinal tests.
analysis_zh: 从经历到代码库的转移是具体巩固机制。避免权重更新本身不能保证不遗忘，检索干扰、错误抽象和库扩展不兼容仍需长期测试。

summary_en: H²-EMV incrementally builds hierarchical episodic memory from a robot's multimodal experience and selectively forgets content using relevance estimates conditioned on natural-language rules. title: AGM: Achievement-Grounded Memory for Closed-Loop Agents with Frozen VLA Policies
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: Achievement-Grounded Memory tracks a static subgoal sequence with a dynamic progress pointer around a frozen VLA. The pointer advances only after physical verification, using gripper-load cues, point tracking, and cross-view comparison, preventing attempted actions from being silently promoted into completed task progress.
summary_zh: Achievement-Grounded Memory在冻结VLA外围以静态子目标序列和动态进度指针记录状态；夹爪负载、点跟踪和跨视图比较提供物理验证，只有验证达成后才推进指针，避免把尝试动作写成已完成进度。
analysis_en: This isolates memory-update discipline from storage capacity. A trained verification head remains part of the system, and verification errors, static subgoal assumptions, and out-of-domain contacts constrain how broadly the mechanism generalizes.
analysis_zh: 该方法凸显状态更新规范而非存储容量。系统仍包含训练的验证头；验证错误、静态子目标假设与域外接触限制其泛化范围。

title: EventSync: Event-Driven Memory Updates for History-Dependent Manipulation
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: EventSync coordinates a vision-language subgoal planner and VLA executor through event-driven memory updates. A lightweight monitor combines visual observations with end-effector trajectories to assess completion, adding a subgoal to completed history and triggering further reasoning only after obtaining supporting execution evidence.
summary_zh: EventSync通过事件驱动记忆更新协调视觉语言子目标规划器和VLA执行器；轻量监测器结合视觉与末端轨迹判断完成，获得执行证据后才将子目标写入完成历史并触发下一轮推理。
analysis_en: Completion evidence gates both state writing and planning transitions. This isolates update timing as a memory concern; false positive completion, monitor transfer, and recovery from an incorrect committed event remain critical tests.
analysis_zh: 完成证据同时控制状态写入与规划切换，使更新时机成为明确记忆问题；误判完成、监测器迁移和错误提交后的恢复是关键测试。
memory_relevance_en: Event-confirmed completion controls both writes to subgoal history and the timing of subsequent planning.
memory_relevance_zh: 事件确认完成同时控制子目标历史写入和后续规划时机。

title: ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration
date_basis: First arXiv publication date from the official Atom published field; version_date uses updated.
summary_en: ProactiveVLA uses remaining interaction budget after an initial task to explore self-proposed goals involving affordances, state changes, and interaction compositions. Verified outcomes from both task-directed and exploratory episodes are consolidated into memory, giving a reasoning agent broader evidence for subsequent planning around a frozen VLA.
